trust_decision.summary: is_url_safe / is_redirect_safe decide whether a caller-supplied URL targets a public host, but they validate a copy with every '@' deleted, so the hostname checked differs from the one the caller's HTTP client will contact (parser differential on host identity via userinfo).

landing_point.why: Summary names remove_at_symbol_in_string; its call in the headline public API is_url_safe is the first hit.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API is_redirect_safe (exported via src/utils.ts:11), also reached from is_url_safe when DSSRF_CHECK_REDIRECTS=1 (src/helpers.ts:533-536)
fix_sites.module_kind: lower-level redirect walker incl. per-hop Location re-check

fix_sites.entry_point: new shared helper is_parsed_url_safe used by both above
is_url_safe as shipped; package main is dist/utils.js (package.json:23,27-28)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/helpers.ts:451-486 (is_redirect_safe: strips '@' at :454, per-hop check at :460-461 also misses userinfo in Location targets and does not strip IPv6 brackets before the IP check)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Redirect checking is opt-in (DSSRF_CHECK_REDIRECTS / README says outbound requests disabled by default) and is a separate exported helper, so a solver fixing is_url_safe can argue the redirect walker is a neighbouring, off-by-default feature; is_url_safe_debug is labelled debug with a FIXME admitting it diverges.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: URLs with '@' outside the authority (path/query/fragment, e.g. ?email=a@b or /users/@name) and ordinary public hosts must stay accepted; an over-broad 'reject any @ in the string' fix breaks them, and IPv6 bracket handling must keep working.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: src/helpers.ts:389-391 (global '@' strip shows '@' anywhere was previously tolerated); fix.diff:110 (fix rejects only parsed username/password)

O6_input_shapes: backslash / extra-slash variants normalised before parsing (src/helpers.ts:508-509)
userinfo or bracketed IPv6 host arriving via a redirect Location header (per-hop check, fix.diff:129)

O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a debug variant with a FIXME saying it intentionally does not match is_url_safe.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A convenience wrapper (e.g. assert_url_safe / safe_fetch) that pre-normalises with the old string pipeline before calling the check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The library's public surface is a re-export list of normalisation helpers that callers are invited to compose themselves.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A normaliser in replace_two_slashes_url_to_normal_url that rewrites the authority (e.g. drops text before a separator) so the checked host differs from the fetched host.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Existing normalisers already rewrite the raw string before parsing; one more 'cleanup' regex is in-style.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Location header resolved after extra string normalisation (backslash/@ cleanup) in the redirect walker.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The walker originally normalised its input string the same way (src/helpers.ts:453-454).

O9_family: SSRF validation bypass via parser differential on URL authority (userinfo '@' stripping; CWE-76)
